title: ShieldGuard Hartford Main Office
content: ShieldGuard corporate office and full-service agency in Hartford, Connecticut. This is the flagship location with specialists in all lines of insurance: auto, homeowners, renters, life, health supplemental, umbrella, commercial, and motorcycle. The office also handles complex claims that require in-person support and hosts monthly free insurance education seminars open to the public. Walk-ins welcome during business hours. Ample free parking available.

metadata.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM
agents: Karen Mitchell, CPCU - Personal Lines Manager

title: ShieldGuard Chicago Loop Agency
content: ShieldGuard agency office in Chicago's Loop business district, serving the greater Chicago metropolitan area. Specializes in auto, homeowners, and renters insurance for urban customers, as well as condo insurance and umbrella policies. The office is conveniently located one block from the Millennium Park Metra station. On-street metered parking and nearby parking garages available. Bilingual services available in English and Spanish.

metadata.address: 200 S. Michigan Avenue, Suite 1400, Chicago, IL 60604

title: ShieldGuard North Dallas Agency
content: ShieldGuard agency in North Dallas serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Full-service agency specializing in homeowners insurance (including coverage for Texas-specific risks like hail and windstorm), auto insurance, and commercial auto for local businesses. The office is located in the Preston Hollow shopping area with free parking. Saturday appointments available for customers who cannot visit during the week.

metadata.address: 8350 N. Central Expressway, Suite 220, Dallas, TX 75206
metadata.hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM (by appointment)

title: ShieldGuard Atlanta Midtown Agency
content: ShieldGuard agency in Midtown Atlanta, Georgia, serving the Atlanta metro area. Specializes in auto insurance, renters insurance for the large renter population in Midtown, and life insurance planning for young professionals and families. The office is a 5-minute walk from the Midtown MARTA station. The agency frequently partners with local employers to provide group informational sessions on insurance literacy. Free validated parking in the building garage.

metadata.address: 1100 Peachtree Street NE, Suite 450, Atlanta, GA 30309

title: ShieldGuard Scottsdale Agency
content: ShieldGuard agency in Scottsdale, Arizona, serving the greater Phoenix metropolitan area. Specializes in homeowners insurance for desert climates (including monsoon and dust storm coverage), auto insurance, and motorcycle insurance for the year-round riding community. The office is located in the Scottsdale Airpark business district with free lot parking. Extended hours on Wednesdays until 7 PM for after-work appointments.

metadata.address: 7702 E. Doubletree Ranch Road, Suite 110, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
metadata.hours: Mon-Tue, Thu-Fri 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Wed 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM

title: ShieldGuard Bellevue Agency
content: ShieldGuard agency in downtown Bellevue, Washington, serving the Seattle-Bellevue-Tacoma metro area. Specializes in homeowners insurance (including earthquake endorsements for the Pacific Northwest), auto insurance, umbrella policies for high-net-worth individuals, and commercial insurance for tech companies and small businesses. Located in the Bellevue Place office tower with visitor parking validation. The office serves a large tech industry client base and offers evening consultations by appointment.

metadata.hours: Mon-Fri 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, evenings by appointment
